description:
Fetch gnomAD sequencing-coverage summary across a gene, transcript, or region — mean and median read depth, plus the mean fraction of samples covered at each depth threshold (1× through 100×), separated by exome and genome track. Use this to disambiguate a true absent variant from an uncallable position: a variant missing from a well-covered region is informative, while one missing from a poorly-covered region is not. Supply exactly one of gene, transcript_id, or region; a gene or transcript is summarized over its exons ±75 bp, not its introns. gnomAD reports coverage in buckets (bucket_size): 1 bp for a region spanning under 850 bp, otherwise about 1/500 of the queried span. Target bases with no returned bucket (missing_positions) are left out of the figures: their callability is unknown, not zero depth. gnomAD publishes no coverage for subsets, so a subset dataset reads its parent release (gnomad_r4_non_ukb reads gnomad_r4) over all the parent’s samples, named in coverage_dataset. Echoes the effective dataset and build.
Data source: gnomAD (Broad Institute) — https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/

coverage_source.description: Restrict to one coverage track. Omit to return every available track.

dataset.description: gnomAD dataset, default gnomad_r4: gnomad_r4 and its subset gnomad_r4_non_ukb (GRCh38); gnomad_r3 and its subsets gnomad_r3_controls_and_biobanks, gnomad_r3_non_cancer, gnomad_r3_non_neuro, gnomad_r3_non_topmed, gnomad_r3_non_v2 (GRCh38); gnomad_r2_1 and its subsets gnomad_r2_1_controls, gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer, gnomad_r2_1_non_neuro, gnomad_r2_1_non_topmed (GRCh37); exac (GRCh37). A subset keeps part of its parent release's samples (non_cancer drops cancer-study samples, non_ukb UK Biobank's) and can leave a callset unchanged: gnomad_r4_non_ukb genome counts equal gnomad_r4's, and gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer genome counts equal gnomad_r2_1's.

anyOf.description: Gene — HGNC symbol (e.g. PCSK9) or Ensembl gene ID (e.g. ENSG00000169174). Obtain a stable ID from ensembl_lookup_gene.
Blank — the gene is treated as omitted.

gene.description: Gene, as an HGNC symbol or Ensembl gene ID; mitochondrial genes (e.g. MT-TL1) are not served.

reference_genome.description: Reference build, derived from dataset when omitted; a build other than the dataset's is rejected. Keep aligned with Ensembl coordinates.

region.description: Genomic region chrom-start-stop (1-based inclusive, e.g. 1-55039447-55064852) on chromosome 1–22, X, or Y with an optional chr prefix, spanning (stop − start) under 2,500,000 bp.

name: gnomad_get_coverage

coverage_dataset.description: The gnomAD release the coverage was read from: dataset itself, or a subset’s parent release.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_target`: Not exactly one of gene, transcript_id, or region was supplied. `incoherent_build`: reference_genome was supplied but does not match the dataset. `invalid_region`: The region names a chromosome outside 1–22, X, Y, or breaks the coordinate bounds. `region_too_large`: The region spans 2,500,000 bp or more, beyond what gnomAD summarizes at once. `mitochondrial_unsupported`: The gene, transcript, or region is on the mitochondrial chromosome (M or MT). `gene_not_found`: gnomAD holds no gene matching the symbol or Ensembl ID in this build. `transcript_not_found`: gnomAD holds no transcript matching transcript_id in this build. `graphql_error`: gnomAD rejected the coverage query with a GraphQL error. `upstream_unavailable`: gnomAD stayed unavailable or throttled through every retry. `upstream_timeout`: gnomAD attempts timed out or the shared 45 s call budget expired. `upstream_access`: gnomAD refused the request (access denied). `invalid_upstream_response`: gnomAD kept answering with a response that failed validation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Set when a subset was read from its parent release, target bases or a supported track returned no coverage, or the requested track is unsupported.

items.description: Coverage for one track over the target, summarized from its buckets rather than single bases: each fraction is the mean of the buckets’ fractions, which gnomAD rounds up to the next 0.01.

bucket_count.description: Coverage buckets summarized: every returned bucket overlapping the target. gnomAD returns each bucket between a track’s first and last record, so an empty one inside that span counts as zero depth.

bucket_size.description: Width of each coverage bucket in bp.

fraction_over_1.description: Fraction of samples at ≥1×; null when no data.

fraction_over_10.description: Fraction of samples at ≥10×; null when no data.

fraction_over_100.description: Fraction of samples at ≥100×; null when no data.

fraction_over_15.description: Fraction of samples at ≥15×; null when no data.

fraction_over_20.description: Fraction of samples at ≥20×; null when no data.

fraction_over_25.description: Fraction of samples at ≥25×; null when no data.

fraction_over_30.description: Fraction of samples at ≥30×; null when no data.

fraction_over_5.description: Fraction of samples at ≥5×; null when no data.

fraction_over_50.description: Fraction of samples at ≥50×; null when no data.

mean_depth.description: Mean of the summarized buckets’ mean depths; null when no data.

median_depth.description: Median of the summarized buckets’ depths (each the average of its per-base medians); null when no data.

missing_positions.description: Target bases without returned coverage buckets (target_positions minus positions).

positions.description: Target bases inside the summarized buckets; short of target_positions when the track has no records at the target’s edges, typically outside the exome capture.

source.description: Which gnomAD coverage track this summary covers.

target_positions.description: Total target bases: start..stop inclusive for a region, the merged padded exons for a gene or transcript.

target.description: The resolved target (gene symbol/ID, transcript ID, or region) the coverage describes.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: get coverage
